```{r}
Bac.AllG<-readRDS(file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/BacArch_min2_rare9048_v1.rds")

Fun.AllG<-readRDS(file="../processed_data/clean_rds_saves/Fun_min2_rare10116_v2.rds")

samplenames <- data.frame("Bac_samplenames" = sample_names(Bac.AllG),
                          "Fun_samplenames" = c(sample_names(Fun.AllG), rep("null", (length(sample_names(Bac.AllG))-length(sample_names(Fun.AllG))))),
                          check.rows = F)

write.csv(samplenames,row.names = F,file="../metadata/samplenames.csv")
```



# adonis2 tables
```{r, eval=F, cache=T}
# create container array (dim = c(nrow, ncol, n_df))
adonis.out_predGrass.list = vector("list", length = length(comm.names.by.grass[1:2]))

for (comm in comm.names.by.grass[1:2]) {
  adonis.temp_predGrass <- adonis2(phyloseq::distance(get(comm), method="bray") ~ Grass, 
          data = (as(sample_data(get(comm)), "data.frame")))
  
  adonis.temp_predGrass$comm <- comm 
  
  adonis.out_predGrass.list[[comm]] <- (as.data.frame(adonis.temp_predGrass))

  }

adonis.out.array_predGrass = do.call(rbind, adonis.out_predGrass.list)
```

```{r, eval=F}
results <- lapply(colnames(comm.names.by.grass), function(x)
```

```{r, eval=F}
#code for running lots of metadata against comm
comm.meta.long <- (as(sample_data(get(comm)), "data.frame"))
# comm.meta.long[,c(8,19:20)] # 5-Site, 8-Grass, 19-Gradient, 20-Bin
comm.meta <- subset(comm.meta.long, select=Grass) # 5-Site, 8-Grass, 19-Gradient, 20-Bin

# lappy to 'loop' aov results by metadata col into df
results <- lapply(colnames(comm.meta), function(x){
  form <- as.formula(paste(comm, x, sep="~")) 
  z <- adonis2(form, data = comm.meta, permutations=99)
  return(as.data.frame(z$aov.tab)) #convert anova table to a data frame
}
)

# see 1st element
  # results[[1]]

# name the list elements with the appropriate variable
names(results) <- colnames(comm.meta)

# convert to df
results <- do.call(rbind, results)
```




# taxonomy

# old {.hidden}

Bacterial-Archaeal Phylum Relative Abundance 

\
*Note:* Bacterial and archaeal phyla with a global abundance of \< 2% relative abundance have been agglomerated into "\< 2% relative abundance"\

```{r Bac-Phylum-Full-GrassRep-Site, message=F, warning=F, error=F, fig.dim = c(12, 9), out.width = "100%", eval=F, echo=F}
# facet site

ggplot(dat_Bac.Phylum.r, aes(x = Grass_Rep, 
                             y = as.numeric(Abundance*100), 
                             fill = Phylum)) + 
  # facet_grid(Reach~., labeller = labeller(Reach = reach_name2))+
  facet_wrap("Site", nrow=4, ncol=6, scales = "free_x")+
  # geom_vline(xintercept = 2, color="black")+
  labs(x= '\nGrass x Replicate', y="Relative Abundance", fill="Phylum")+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position="fill")+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 1))+
  # scale_fill_jco() + # max 10 colors
  # scale_fill_igv() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Bac_Phylum_cols) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=7, angle = 90, hjust=1,vjust=.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    strip.text = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=12),
    legend.text = element_text(color="black", size=10),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color="black", size=14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color="black", size=14, angle=90),
    plot.title = element_text(size=14),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # switch off major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # switch off minor gridlines
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=.75)
  )

#tax fig naming: Dataset_Taxlevel_subset_xaxis_facet
ggsave(file="../figures/taxa_plots/BA_Phylum_Full_GrassRep_Site.png", plot = last_plot(), width=12, height=9, units = "in", device="png")
```

### **Across Different Sites by Grass Hosts** {.unnumbered .tabset}

```{r, echo=F, results='asis'}
#cut=Site
#color=Grass
#carat=sample_name
#clarity=Phylum
#price=Abundance
#col=fill

BA_tabs <- sort(unique(dat_Bac.Phylum.r2$Site))



for(tab in BA_tabs) {

  cat('\n')

  cat('#### ', tab, '{.unnumbered .tabset .tabset-pills}   \n')

  cat('\n')


  sub_values <- dat_Bac.Phylum.r2 %>% filter(Site == tab)

  subtabs <- sort(unique(sub_values$Grass))


  for(subtab in subtabs) {

    cat('\n')

    cat('##### ', subtab, '{.unnumbered}   \n')

    cat('\n')

    plot_values <- sub_values %>% filter(Grass == subtab)


    print(ggplot(plot_values, aes(x = sample_name,y = as.numeric(Abundance*100), fill = Phylum)) +
          geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c( "< 2% relative abundance"="#CBD588",
                    "Acidobacteria"="#5F7FC7",
                    "Actinobacteria"="orange",
                    "Armatimonadetes"="#DA5724",
                    "Bacteroidetes"="#508578",
                    "Candidatus_Saccharibacteria"="#CD9BCD",
                    "Chloroflexi"="#AD6F3B",
                    "Firmicutes"="#673770",
                    "Planctomycetes"="#D14285",
                    "Proteobacteria"="#652926",
                    "Verrucomicrobia"="#C84248")) +
          labs(x = '\n Site x Grass x Replicate',
               y = 'Relative Abundance \n',
               fill = 'Phylum') +
          theme_bw()+
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(color="black", size=9, angle = 90, hjust=1,vjust=.5),
            axis.text.y = element_text(color="black", size=12),
            strip.text = element_text(color="black", size=12),
            strip.background = element_blank(),
            legend.title = element_text(color="black", size=12),
            legend.text = element_text(color="black", size=10),
            legend.key.height = unit(0.5, 'cm'),
            axis.title.x = element_text(color="black", size=14),
            axis.title.y = element_text(color="black", size=14, angle=90),
            plot.title = element_text(size=14),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # switch off major gridlines
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # switch off minor gridlines
            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, linewidth=.75)
            )
          )


    cat('\n')

  }

}
```

```{r Fun-Order-Full-SiteRep-Grass, message=F, warning=F, error=F, fig.dim = c(10, 10), out.width = "100%", eval=F, echo=F}
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # switch off major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # switch off minor gridlines
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=.75)
  )

#tax fig naming: Dataset_Taxlevel_subset_xaxis_facet
ggsave(file="../figures/taxa_plots/Fun_Order_Full_SiteRep_Grass.png", plot = last_plot(), width=10, height=10, units = "in", device="png")
```
